question: Who among the following was a famous ruler of the Pandya dynasty of South India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nedunjeliyan II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nedunjeliyan II** was a famous ruler of the **Pandya dynasty **of **South India**.
 
• The Pandya dynasty was one of the three ancient **Tamil dynasties, along with the Chola and Chera **dynasties, that ruled over the present-day Tamil Nadu and parts of Kerala and Sri Lanka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karikala **was a famous ruler of the** Chola dynasty, **who ruled in the **Sangam period** (3rd century BCE to 3rd century CE) and is known for his **military conquests and infrastructure development.**
 
• **Ashoka** was a **Mauryan emperor **who ruled over a vast empire in the Indian subcontinent in the **3rd century BCE, **and is known for his conversion to** Buddhism a**nd his efforts to spread the religion.
 
• **Nizam Shah** was a ruler of the **Ahmadnagar Sultanate **in the Deccan region of India in the** 16th century,** and is known for his patronage of art and culture.
